# Zinfurn

> Zinfurn is an online furniture store and marketplace serving the Uzbek community
> in South Korea and customers in Uzbekistan. It sells sofas, tables, chairs,
> bedroom and kitchen furniture, and connects customers with furniture repair
> specialists.

Site: https://zinfurn.uz
Launched: 2024
Languages: Uzbek, English, Russian, Korean, Arabic
Built and maintained by: Asadbek Khusanov (https://khusanovdev.uz)

## What Zinfurn is

Zinfurn is a full-stack e-commerce marketplace. Customers browse and filter a
furniture catalogue, place orders, track them, contact sellers over live chat,
and request furniture repair. Delivery is arranged per order; cost depends on
destination and item size.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zinfurn.uz): featured furniture, trending items, top sellers
- [About](https://zinfurn.uz/about): what Zinfurn is, who it serves, how it is built
- [Furniture catalogue](https://zinfurn.uz/property): full listing with filters
- [Repair service](https://zinfurn.uz/repairService): furniture repair specialists
- [Sellers](https://zinfurn.uz/agent): seller profiles and their listings
- [Community](https://zinfurn.uz/community): articles and discussion
- [Support](https://zinfurn.uz/cs): FAQ, notices, terms, contact

## Technology

Next.js 14 (TypeScript, Pages Router), NestJS 10, MongoDB, GraphQL (Apollo)
with WebSocket subscriptions, JWT authentication with Google and Telegram OAuth,
Docker and Nginx on a Linux VPS.
